theories.basis: Assigned behavioral_concerns: 'Changed docs misstate QA numeric limits, defaults or hard maxima versus product configuration, allowing user to set values that exceed maxima or are rejected at startup'. This shard is a follow-up shard (qa-v1-shard-2f95815d337e9e0f14bf102a) with changed_paths:null and only context_paths (docs/*) visible; the primary misstatement is therefore expected in the changed set, not directly readable here. Context docs propagate the same table and therefore inherit risk.
theories.verification_surface: Compare the documented QA table in docs/cli-reference.md:371-403 (defaults and hard maxima) and related numeric claims in docs/user-guide.md:96-109, docs/recovery.md:195, docs/architecture.md:168 against the product-owned effective limits that enforce startup validation (precedence product default → ultraplan.yml → environment, positive integers, cannot exceed hard maximum). Requires product config source, limit definitions, and startup validation code.
theories.confirmation_condition: A limit shown in changed_docs (or its copy in context docs) has a hard maximum or default higher/lower than the code-enforced maximum/default; setting the documented maximum in ultraplan.yml or ULTRAPLAN_QA_* is rejected with configuration error, or setting a value between the true maximum and the documented maximum is accepted per docs but should be rejected.
theories.refutation_condition: Every QA key's documented default and hard maximum in changed_docs and in docs/cli-reference.md matches the code-enforced defaults and maxima exactly, and lower-only enforcement matches 'A default equal to its maximum can still be lowered' semantics with no observable startup rejection for documented maxima.
theories.inconclusive_condition: Product configuration source or limit enforcement code is not available in this read-only context-paths-only view (changed_paths:null, no implementation files), or the changed doc set cannot be listed, so comparison cannot be completed.
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only listing and bounded reads of changed_docs set plus product-owned limit definitions via approved context expansion (e.g., internal/sprint/* that owns budgets/policy, internal/config/* that validates qa.* keys) and compare each row of the CLI reference table; do not attempt writes, shell execution, or startup with mutated config.

theories.basis: docs/cli-reference.md:371-403 is the user-facing source of truth for 29 QA keys, stating 'Integer limits and durations must be positive and cannot exceed the listed hard maximum' and that workspace/environment may only lower limits. docs/user-guide.md:96-109 repeats lower-only policy with example lowering, and docs/recovery.md:195 repeats retained_attempts 8 / state_bytes 128MiB. If any table maximum exceeds the code-enforced maximum, user can set a value that docs claim is valid but startup rejects with exit 3.

theories.confirmation_condition: At least one key in docs/cli-reference.md has documented hard maximum ≠ code-enforced hard maximum (e.g., documented 400000 vs code 200000, or documented 64 vs code 32) or documented default ≠ code default, demonstrable by inspecting product config limit constants and validation that caps ultraplan.yml / ULTRAPLAN_QA_* values.
theories.refutation_condition: All 29 rows in docs/cli-reference.md plus the ancillary numeric claims (retained_attempts 8, state_bytes 134217728, shared prefix 256KiB) exactly match the code-enforced defaults and hard maxima, and the lower-only rule is correctly described with startup rejecting only values > true maximum.
theories.inconclusive_condition: Product-owned QA limit definitions and validation logic are outside the assigned context_paths and not readable without a bounded context expansion; without them the table cannot be confirmed or refuted.
